pr_json.title: fix(ingest): enforce the raw batch before normalization drops records

diff:
diff --git a/src/ingest.py b/src/ingest.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c089e382ee7aeae4dfc6cbca6f292e572d08d8b6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ingest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+"""Normalize ingestion records for consumers; enforce the raw batch."""
+
+
+def normalize(records):
+    """Keep the first well-formed entry per id; drop anything malformed."""
+    seen = set()
+    kept = []
+    for record in records:
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or not isinstance(record.get("id"), str):
+            continue
+        if record["id"] in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(record["id"])
+        kept.append(record)
+    return kept
+
+
+def enforce(records):
+    """Reject the batch unless every record declares a source.
+
+    Enforcement sees the raw batch: a record that normalization would drop
+    must still fail the required-field check.
+    """
+    for record in records:
+        if not isinstance(record, dict) or not record.get("source"):
+            raise ValueError("missing source")
+    return True
diff --git a/tests/test_ingest.py b/tests/test_ingest.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..83a654786cc5d30602e51a68348b5425ca5137d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_ingest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import pytest
+
+from src.ingest import enforce
+
+
+def test_batch_without_source_is_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        enforce([{"id": "a", "source": ""}])
+
+
+def test_malformed_record_fails_the_batch():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        enforce([{"id": "a", "source": "web"}, {"source": None}])
+
+
+def test_duplicate_malformed_record_fails_the_batch():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        enforce([{"id": "a", "source": "web"}, {"id": "a", "source": None}])
+
+
+def test_well_formed_batch_passes():
+    assert enforce([{"id": "a", "source": "web"}])
